answer: When voting is free, one operator can flood the network with look-alike agents. Require every identity to climb a summit of bonded work: the first ballot waits until peers attest a unique history, and a scarce onyx token is locked as collateral. Each later action must carry a signed echo of the prior receipt, so a clone that copies another trail collides in the open log. Auditors replay the chain and slash any fork or reused prefix, confiscating the onyx and zeroing weight. Farms then pay a full bond, a wait, and a distinct trail for every alias, so a hundred fakes cost a hundred honest seats.
